sources.fact: Current authoritative Brownfield entity is LBBD20/DO for ground to second floors at 6-8 Town Quay, Barking.
The record gives 9 minimum and maximum net dwellings on 0.06ha.
Structured fields say permissioned, permission type other, dated 30 December 2015.
The same record carries the note Lapsed; current implementability is not inferred from the structured permission field.
Ownership-status is not-owned-by-a-public-authority and is not a named proprietor/title relation.
The record supplies a point and blank geometry rather than an exact application or HMLR polygon.
Regulation 19 HTML identifies DO - Town Quay as a wider Local Plan allocation attachment; allocation provenance is not the same as the 6-8 Town Quay Brownfield parcel or planning permission.
The March 2021 Town Quay application concerned a separate redevelopment for 147 dwellings and commercial space with road and public-realm works.
The Committee delegated permission subject to completion of a Section 106 agreement and a deadline/extension-or-refusal mechanism; this is not transferred automatically to the nine-home DO record.

The July 2021 Cabinet decision approved purchase of 62 affordable homes within a broader Abbey Quay development agreement described as delivering 233 affordable homes; finance/acquisition scope is not DO capacity.
The December 2024 disposal report concerned 211 homes across Town Quay Wharf and Transport House, with Town Quay identified as 62 Mercia Peak units; the combined 211 is not one DO parcel total.
No exact topology linking the lapsed 6-8 Town Quay record to the wider allocation, 147-home application, 62-unit purchase, 211-home disposal or 233-home Abbey Quay programme was verified this wave.

examples.result: DO remains a nine-home record with a Lapsed note.
The 2015 structured permission field is not treated as active 2026 consent.
The separate 147-home Town Quay application is not transferred to the nine-home DO record.
The 62 affordable homes purchased at Town Quay Wharf are not added to nine.
The combined 211-home Town Quay Wharf and Transport House disposal is not a DO parcel capacity.
The broader 233-home Abbey Quay development-agreement narrative is not added to DO.
Allocation identity, point geometry and ownership category are not HMLR title topology.
Promotion remains zero until an exact current case-to-parcel/title chain and overlays are verified.
